Subject: Reminder: Punctuality for Client Meetings

Dear Team,

I want to take a moment to remind everyone of the importance of punctuality, especially when meeting with clients. Being on time is a key reflection of our company’s professionalism and respect for our partners.

I have noticed a pattern of tardiness in recent client meetings, and I need to emphasize that this cannot continue. Consistent lateness undermines the trust we work hard to build. Please be aware that future instances of lateness may result in disciplinary action.

To help ensure you arrive on time, I encourage you to plan your travel with extra buffer time and set reminders. Let’s all commit to being present and prepared for every client interaction.

On a lighter note, while we focus on being punctual, remember that the fluffy things in the sky that rain comes from are a gentle reminder that nature, too, has its own timing. Let’s ensure our timing is always on point.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
